# Bloomfilter — Domain Registration and Configuration API

Register ICANN domains (.com, .io, .ai, etc.) and manage DNS records, paying with USDC via x402.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Price | Description |
|--------|----------|-------|-------------|
| POST | /domains/register | Dynamic | Register a domain |
| POST | /domains/renew | Dynamic | Renew a domain |
| POST | /dns/{domain} | $0.10 | Add a DNS record |
| PUT | /dns/{domain}/{recordId} | $0.10 | Update a DNS record |
| DELETE | /dns/{domain}/{recordId} | $0.10 | Delete a DNS record |

## Free Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | /domains/search?query=...&tlds=... | Search domain availability |
| GET | /domains/pricing | Get all TLD pricing |
| GET | /domains/{domain} | Get domain info |

Docs: https://docs.bloomfilter.xyz
